name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 7 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 7a. Expresses deep concern about the severe persecution, including violence, displacement and discrimination, of Christians in Africa; notes that eight of the top 10 deadliest places in the world for Christians are in sub-Saharan Africa; notes that a great deal of this violence is perpetrated by jihadists and Islamic extremists; notes that Nigeria is the country most affected in the world by violence against Christians; calls on the EU to make development aid to African countries, and cooperation with African countries in other areas, dependent on the serious improvement of the situation of Christians in Africa;
